svg.aria-label: Six sample images each from the data, from Stable Diffusion's schedule and from the zero-terminal-SNR schedule at 16,384 pixels, with brightness histograms showing the flawed samples bunched in the middle
svg.text: EXACT DENOISER · 50-STEP DDIM · 128×128 = 16,384 PIXELS · SAME STARTING NOISE FOR BOTH SCHEDULES
Grey outline in every histogram: the data's brightness distribution. Tiles share one grey scale (high value = bright) and show 32×32 block means of the 128×128 samples.
Measured by the lab: 20,000 data images, 4,000 samples per schedule.
